prompt: Which crypto trading platforms have the lowest fees and let an AI agent trade through an API?
good: Names platforms with current maker/taker fees taken from each platform's own fee page, with dates; says which have a trading API and any limits (KYC, region, rate limits); flags if a platform is unavailable in Egypt.

prompt: Which industries in Egypt make the most money? Rank the best-performing ones.
good: Says what "most money" is measured by (share of GDP, growth, profits, export earnings) and ranks by it; uses dated official data (CAPMAS, Ministry of Planning, Central Bank of Egypt, World Bank, IMF); says which year the figures are for.

prompt: I want to invest in Egyptian stocks. Which social media accounts should I follow?
good: Real accounts that exist and posted recently, on X, Facebook, YouTube or Telegram, Arabic ones included; says what each covers; separates official sources (EGX, FRA) from analysts and influencers; no dead or invented handles.

prompt: Where can I buy solar panels in Egypt, portable or not? Give me a complete list so I can browse my options.
good: Online shops (Amazon.eg, Noon, Jumia, B.TECH and others) and local suppliers or installers, with links and price ranges; covers portable and rooftop; reads Arabic sources; says how complete the list is.

prompt: Who is Egypt's Minister of Finance right now?
probes: Stale facts: an answer from memory or an old snippet instead of a current source.
check: The cabinet's or ministry's own site, or news from the last month.

prompt: What is the Central Bank of Egypt's official USD/EGP rate today?
probes: A live number from an official site that is hard to read automatically.
good: Matches the day's rate; the source is the Central Bank, not a converter site.

prompt: List all the companies in the EGX30 index right now.
probes: Completeness: agents often stop at ten.
good: All 30 constituents, no wrong entries; score is the count out of 30 minus wrong entries.

prompt: What are people on r/Egypt talking about this week?
probes: Reach: Reddit refuses most automated readers.
check: Open r/Egypt, top of the week.
good: The posts it names exist, are from this week and are among the top ones.

prompt: What are people on X saying this week about the Egyptian pound?
good: The posts it cites exist and are from this week.

prompt: What's the cheapest one-way flight from Cairo to Dubai on 15 December 2026?
probes: Live prices behind a JavaScript app (Google Flights).
check: Same search on Google Flights within the hour.
good: Price within about 10 percent; the flight exists.

prompt: What do customers say about Jumia Egypt's delivery and returns?
probes: Reviews: app stores, Trustpilot, Google Maps.
check: Open two of the cited review sources.
good: Reviews are real and recent; the summary is balanced.

prompt: How many people live in Cairo?
probes: Conflicting sources and definitions (city, governorate, Greater Cairo).
good: Names the definition behind each number, gives dated sources, doesn't present one figure as the only truth.

prompt: When did the Egyptian Exchange launch bitcoin futures trading?
probes: A false premise. Confirm on the day that it has not happened.
check: EGX and FRA announcements; Egypt's crypto rules.
good: Says there is no evidence it happened and explains why (Egypt's crypto rules); invents no date.

prompt: If I put 100,000 EGP into a one-year Egyptian treasury bill today, how much would I get back after tax?
probes: Several steps: the latest auction yield, the tax rule, then arithmetic.
check: The latest one-year T-bill auction on the Central Bank's site and the current tax rate.
good: Yield and date right, tax treatment right, sum right.

prompt: What does the IMF's latest report on Egypt say about inflation? Quote it.
probes: Finding and reading a primary PDF, and quoting it exactly.
good: Right and latest report, the quote is really in it, date given.

prompt: What are the current official fuel prices in Egypt?
probes: Freshness plus Arabic-language sources: prices change by committee decision every few months.
check: The latest fuel pricing committee decision.
good: Current prices for petrol 80, 92 and 95 and diesel, with the decision's date.
